public_definitions: Goal: Review the Product Rating Share dashboard, then open the product attribute follow-up item for the category with the highest current labeled rating share.
Rule: Select the category with the highest current labeled rating share.
Decision metric: mislabeled_value / labeled rating share.
Business reason: Highest-share attribute has the strongest current customer demand signal.
Form options: Select Price, Select Support, Select Design.
